events.title: Proposed ruling: refund_partial $2.40 (model confidence 0.66)

Safety screen first: the whole chat (F9 stop request at 14:17, F10 driver's "Sure"), the driver's post-trip statement F12 and the rider's complaint contain no threat, intimidation, harassment, sexual remark or dangerous-driving allegation; the words read as an ordinary parcel-stop request and a fare complaint [F9][F10][F12][SAFE-1][SAFE-2]. Safety_concern is therefore "none".

This is a RydeTAXI metered trip, so extra distance feeds directly into the fare: F8 charges base $3.90 + distance $14.65 (10.39 km) + time $4.16 + waiting $1.15 + platform $1.47 = $25.33 [F8]; RD-2's metered branch applies rather than a fixed-quote branch [RD-2].

The trip overshot the optimal route by 2.0 km / +23% (F1) and the trace settles one off-route segment, F4 (14:21–14:31; 3.81 km driven against 2.11 km optimal, +1.70 km) [F1][F4][RD-1]. No traffic excuse survives: no incident within the window (F15) and the only bands are 4 and 3, not band 1 or 2, with light rain not a "reasonable cause" [F13][F14][F15][F16][RD-4]. The driver's side concedes this.

The rider's only pre-segment message is F9, sent 14:17: "Can you stop at Clementi Mall? I need to grab a parcel, 3-4 minutes", accepted by F10 at 14:17 [F9][F10][F11]. That is a rider-named place given before the segment, and the car did stop there — F2 records 4 min 0 s stationary at 14:23–14:27, a non-pickup, non-drop-off point inside the segment window — so on RD-3(a) the segment driven to reach the named place and the stop itself are not a deviation, and I do not split off "the way there" [F2][F4][RD-3]. The stop's duration ($1.15 meter waiting at $0.26/min) is chargeable and unclaimed: RD-3(c) leaves meter waiting with the rider on RydeTAXI [F6][RD-3]. FARE-1 is not engaged — no surge (F7), no unpublished add-on, and every line of F8 is a metered or published item — and with no tolls field FARE-2 adds nothing [F7][F8][FARE-1][FARE-2].

What RD-3(a) does not excuse is the rest of the measured segment: the trace's segment stretches 3.81 km where the optimal route covers 2.11 km, yet the car was stationary only 4 minutes of the ten, leaving roughly 6 minutes of driving beyond the named stop, and nothing in the record places that driving on the route to Clementi Mall [F2][F4]. C4's own admission and D4's weakness both concede the fact table names no roads for the driven path, and F12 names no road either, so there is nothing tying the surplus driving to the agreed stop; the agreement's reach over that surplus is therefore not established, and I read the scope as unreadable rather than as consent [F12][G13][RD-5]. The trace's three question marks are thus resolved on one and the same reading — surplus distance not covered by consent counts. Rather than leave a finding undetermined when it changes the amount, I take the conservative branch: the unexempted portion is the residual extra distance inside the segment, 1.70 km [F4].

Amount: RD-2 refunds Σ(unexempted extra_km) × this trip's per-km rate, the rate being F5's distance fare ÷ distance km: $14.65 ÷ 10.39 km = $1.4100/km; 1.70 km × $1.4100/km = $2.3970 → $2.40 [F4][F5][F8][RD-2]. The rest of the trip's +2.0 km (F1), and F5's separate 1.96 km billed excess, are not refundable [F1][F5][RD-2]. The $1.15 waiting line is not refunded [F6][RD-3].

Because a segment is found non-exempt and F18 shows route_disputes_upheld_90d = 2 (two prior upheld route disputes in 90 days), this case makes the breach repeated and the account flag follows: flag_account applies per RD-6 [F18][RD-6]. Profile facts are used only for that add-on, not to prove the deviation [F18][RD-6].

Evidence: the record settles every element this ruling needs — measured segment and distances (F1, F4), the stop and its position (F2), complete timestamped chat (F9–F11), fare lines (F5–F8), traffic (F13–F15) and the driver's history (F18) [F11][RD-3][RD-5]. Evidence_status is sufficient.
